title: Source file list
responsibility: Renders source file rows with optional external links and a supplied per-file action.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.files
inputs.description: Actual source paths, in display order.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.href
inputs.description: Optional external GitHub destination for each path.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.children
inputs.description: The existing action for each source file.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.label
inputs.description: Accessible list name, defaulting to Source files; test lists supply Test files.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.empty
inputs.description: Caller-supplied empty message for the selected file collection.

inputs.name: SourceFileList.relativeTo
inputs.description: Directory prefix omitted from matching display labels. Complete paths remain in hover text and links, and are passed to each file action.

outputs.name: SourceFileList
outputs.description: Responsive file rows with links opening in a new tab, or plain paths when no GitHub repository is known. Empty input states that no file is recorded.
